verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Inngest exposing its own MCP server so that external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) can inspect/operate Inngest — i.e., Inngest is the MCP server, not the client. There is no evidence that Inngest or AgentKit lets a user plug in third-party MCP servers so Inngest's own agents can consume their tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of AgentKit or Inngest functions acting as an MCP client, configuring/connecting external MCP servers, or invoking tools from them.
